name: Complete Two-Layer Basis for Cover-Recursive Peripheral Partial Cubes
statement: An irredundant ample two-layer partial cube $O=\Lambda(A,B)$ is a forbidden pc-minor for the cover-recursively peripheral class exactly when: $A$, $B$, and $A\cup B$ belong to that class; the layers are incomparable and together witness both orientations of every surviving layer coordinate; and no proper simultaneous descendant of $(A,B)$ obtained by common layer-coordinate restrictions and contractions retains those two nonperipherality conditions. Together with the antipodally punctured cubes $Q_n^{--}$, these lifts form the complete forbidden pc-minor basis. Every coordinate of an ample obstruction may serve as the outer coordinate.
proof: For an ample obstruction, the two sections and contraction at any chosen coordinate are proper pc-minors and lie in the class, while periphery-freeness gives the two-layer defect conditions. Every proper simultaneous descendant is another proper minor and must expose a periphery. Conversely, operations using the outer coordinate land in a minor of $A$, $B$, or $A\cup B$. A descendant retaining the outer coordinate either has an empty or nested layer, giving an immediate recursive construction, or condition three supplies a peripheral layer coordinate; induction on the surviving coordinates puts both children in the class. Thus every proper minor lies in the class while the original lift does not.
